title: Shannon's 1948 mathematical theory of communication
summary: Shannon defined an information entropy distinct from, and later compared with, thermodynamic entropy.
body: C. E. Shannon, "A Mathematical Theory of Communication" (Bell System Technical Journal, 1948), defined a measure of uncertainty for a message source. People call it Shannon entropy. It shares a mathematical shape with statistical-mechanical entropy and it is not the same quantity as the entropy of a steam engine. The v1 article's formula H = −Σ p log p is the standard expression of Shannon's measure; this card cites the paper rather than re-deriving it.
